notes.title: Version 0.9.9h patch
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone.
Here's a quick minor patch of tiny tweaks and fixes.

Version 0.9.9h changes:

- Cloud Loading was implemented. Be aware that the game will now overwrite your local copy with the one in the Cloud when it is opened. Should you have multiple computers with save data running the game, both will be synchronised to the save data stored in Steam Cloud when you open v0.9.9h next.
- Evaluation screen now shows scores with commas
- High scores that exceed 1 billion points no longer overlap the name display in Story Mode
- Made Nanamia silver trophy obtainable
- Trophies should now be consistently obtainable in Spell Practice
- Fixed a bug concerning Assist options that would cause non-integer scores to occur
- Hopefully fixed errant bug involving bell damage objects not generating seemingly at random
- Removed revenge bullet behavior from Ultra Mode patterns involving enemies that surround the player in Stage 5 and in the pattern "Aletheian Aptitude"
- Updated the BGM file for "Praecantor's Chime of Kairos"
- Enabled beta translations for Spanish and Japanese in the Options menu (You may encounter visual bugs!)
- Green Label high score board now visible
- Fixed a bug where the "My Score" Steam Leaderboards view pulled up the score 5 places after yours and nobody else
- Adjusted some Valediction Stage enemy patterns to be a little less overwhelming
- Also made those patterns actually less challenging on Casual Mode
- Casual mode scaling now exists for the attacks "Beasts' Rising from the Primordial Ooze," "Crown of Avalant"
- Adjusted firing pattern of "Beasts' Rising from the Primordial Ooze"
- Valediction now allows for up to 40 hits before setting your Evasion bonus to 10 points, instead of 8
- Cleaned up some debug settings that were left in the build

Please post in the community discussions or feel free to join the Lunacy Indeterminate Discord Server (https://discord.gg/gARjCvhn) if you encounter any issues with the update. Thank you!

notes.title: Version 0.9.9 of Bell Spell is now Live
notes.notes:
My immense apologies for keeping you waiting. Between moving halfway across the country and starting a new full-time job, the kinda-solo dev life has not the easiest around here!

Moving on.
Today, I'm thrilled to bring you version 0.9.9 of Praecantor Lila ~ Bell Spell.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41769726/405c79a6f55cf497c608ff02b8ba6ea999f6ffec.png
In this version, those of you who have cleared the game before should now have access to the new chapter, Valediction. It takes place 3 weeks after the end of Bell Spell's main campaign, and follows Lila as she ties up a loose end or two.

Additionally, the Ultra Mode difficulty is now accessible. In order to play Ultra Mode, you must have cleared the game on Super first. It is absolutely not for the faint of heart. GPU, perhaps, also.

This update also includes Steam Achievements and Leaderboard support. Unfortunately, the in-game trophy case isn't close to ready yet, so I'm afraid the Steam client is currently the only way to view your achievement progress.

Once you've obtained a specific achievement, the Green Label arrange mode will be available for selection from the Arcade Mode menu. This mode will swap out ALL your magical spells, and change the behaviors of the Bells!

The Tutorial has been refactored - it has been split into two sections, the first teaches basic controls and the second goes in-depth about bell mechanics.

Accessibility Options have been split off from Casual Mode and can now be toggled regardless of difficulty setting. Additional Accessibility options have been added to the Configurations menu, as well. Accessibility modes will not directly affect unlock or Achievement progress, but they will affect your scoring potential.

New art assets were added for nearly all of the bosses in the game, from portraits to in-game sprites! Animations and expressions remain underway, and backgrounds and menu polish are still pending.

Please enjoy! Fingers crossed, our next updates should definitely come faster than this last one.
Soon, we aim to bring the fully-realised Stage Practice, and Pure Invocation Attacks to Spell Practice. Following that, Story Scenes, and the full Ending and Credits Sequences.

Thank you for your support!
